text:
claire: Quick follow-up from the kv-cache postmortem — we need concrete test coverage and owners for next steps. Posting a compact plan.

devin: I'll own the regression harness for kv-cache edge cases (unit + small integration). Plan: add `tests/kv_cache/inject_miss.py` and a nightly CI job scoped to regression. ETA 12 business days.

priya: I'll create the prompt set for fallback & token-corruption cases. Will include 40 prompts, expected outputs, and fail labels. Path: `evals/incidents/kv-cache/fallback_set.md`. ETA 7 business days.

leo: Ops: I'll add a monthly chaos drill to the schedule and tweak sampling for failed completions. Proposed window: first Wed 10:00-13:00 PT for 3 months. I'll also implement sampling x5 post-deploy for 48h. ETA 2 days.

claire: Can we specify acceptance criteria? Suggestions: regression must detect injected 8-12% kv-miss, nightly evals must show fallback success >= 99.5%, load p95 < 260ms for short bursts, chaos must re-route within 60s.

devin: I will add a kv-miss injector that simulates 10% miss and assert fallback success >= 99% and absence of token corruption. CI gate: fail if token-error > 0.15%.

priya: Prompt set will include adversarial encodings and truncated context cases. I'll add a small runner that posts results to the evals dashboard and kicks on canary traffic daily.

ops-bot: Reminder: create calendar event for chaos drills and tag on-call for the window.

leo: Chaos playbook draft: kill 1 serving shard for 15m under steady traffic, monitor routing fallback, token integrity, and latency waterfall. Document steps + rollback criteria.

claire: Devin/Priya/Leo — please paste PR/links into the postmortem tracker. I'll consolidate owners & timelines and follow up next Friday.

deploy-bot: When regression and evals are green, file `/deploy staged` for the staged rollout.

claire: thanks — small, targeted steps so we can close the loop on this one :white_check_mark:
